data.name: HomeTitle
data.value: Accessible Blazor components under a strict security policy

data.name: HomeLead
data.value: A component library built for applications that forbid inline style, require accessibility, and want a theme they can drive end to end.

data.name: PillarCspBody
data.value: No inline style attribute, no injected style element, no dynamic script evaluation. The library runs under a policy that refuses all of it.

data.name: PillarThemeBody
data.value: Colours, type, spacing, radii, shadows and the chart palette all go through CSS variables, with no value frozen inside a rule.

data.name: PillarA11yBody
data.value: Roles, states and labels are checked by the test suite, not merely promised by the documentation.

data.name: PillarWeightBody
data.value: The published package is measured against a byte budget on every build, stylesheet included.

data.name: DocsLead
data.value: From installing the package to your first custom theme, in five steps.

data.name: DocsInstallBody
data.value: The library is referenced like any other NuGet package.

data.name: DocsRegisterBody
data.value: A single call registers everything the components need.

data.name: DocsCssBody
data.value: The stylesheet ships as a static asset of the package.

data.name: DocsCspBody
data.value: The library asks for nothing beyond these directives: no inline style, no dynamic script evaluation.

data.name: DocsThemeBody
data.value: Redefining one variable repaints every component that reads it.

data.name: DocsThemePointer
data.value: To compose a full theme without writing CSS:
